rag.text:
Test: TC-4791 — Feature area - Task Scheduling - Period movement - Moving operation on tasks imported from file
Priority: Medium | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-78 Feature area - Task Scheduling - Period movement
Labels: teamembers, teamscheduling

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4216 Moving operation on tasks imported from file
   Expected: Gantt module is loaded. There are no tasks in the scope.
2. Click on the Add task and select Import tasks from file
   Expected: Import from file dialog is loaded
3. Download fileName from the attachments and upload it
   Data: fileName: gantt-2023-05-23T18_20_17.XLSX
   Expected: File is uploaded
4. Select projectName and click the Import button. Confirm by clicking the Proceed button.
   Data: projectName: TC-4216 Moving operation on tasks imported from file
   Expected: Following message is displayed:
Tasks have been successfully imported

Now you can refresh the page to see your tasks.

Refresh the page
5. Click on the Refresh the page button.
   Expected: Page is refreshed.

Imported tasks are displayed:

* TC-4216 Moving operation on tasks imported from file (parent)
* TC-4216 Project (parent)
* TC-4216 Task-1 (parent)
* TC-4216 Task-2 (parent)
* TC-4216 Task-3
6. Move the issueName outside its parent's period
   Data: issueName: TC-4216 Task-3
   Expected: Task is correctly moved. All its parents periods are updated.
